tests.title: Available Tests
tests.subtitleLead: You'll open brief instructions first; the timer starts only after you pick a mode. Submit when done for scored results and topic insights. Mocks you build yourself appear under
tests.subtitleTrail: on this page (they are not mixed into the public catalog below).

tests.freePlan: Free plan: {used} / {cap} mocks today · Resets midnight UTC
tests.limitDetail: Timed mocks count toward this cap. Practice mode is still available. You can open an in-progress mock below. New mock starts reset at UTC midnight, or ask your institute or admin for a paid (unlimited) plan.
tests.yourMocksHelp: These are tests you created. Activate them in My Mocks if they are still drafts.
tests.analyticsHint: Recommendations below prioritize tests in those topics—especially ones you haven't taken or scored lower on.
pre.timerOff: Timer off — choose mode to begin
pre.fsBlocked: Fullscreen was blocked or isn't supported—you can continue without it.
pre.headsUpBody: The countdown starts only after you pick Normal or Focus. This is a practice mock—not a camera-proctored exam.
pre.modalSubtitle: Pick how focused you want the environment. PrepMaster does not record camera or audio; "Focus" mode only helps you stay in fullscreen and surfaces stronger reminders if you leave the tab.
pre.normalBullets: Standard mock experience|Flexible — switch tabs if you need to
pre.focusBullets: Prompts for fullscreen (browser permitting)|Hides site navigation during the attempt for a minimal exam screen|Stronger on-screen reminder if you leave this tab|Best when practising serious exam discipline
pre.paletteIntro: The palette uses the same cues as the live test screen:
pre.paletteGrouping: When each row has a subject in the question bank, the live test groups the palette by section and shows section jump controls above the question (same breakdown as the table below).
pre.ans1: Tap an option (A–D) to select. You can change your choice anytime before submitting the whole test.
pre.ans2: Use Next and Previous to move between questions, or jump from the question palette.
pre.ans3: Use Mark for review to flag a question (keyboard M).
pre.ans4: Answers sync in the background. Wait for the timer; when time ends, your attempt submits automatically.
pre.ans5: On the live screen: ← / → move between questions.
